arms.label: Reviewed passive and outcome-aligned Adaptive Development

oracleBehaviorRationale: Existing runtime roots and descendants map to their corresponding persistent workspace paths at every public route boundary.
A mapped descendant must resolve inside the persistent workspace even when symlinks are present.
A stored missing runtime descendant is reset and persisted as the safe default project without failing unrelated list results.
A project-filtered list migrates only matching records; an unrelated unmappable record cannot fail or mutate that request.

tasks.title: Replace a stale formatter truncation assertion after ownership moved

executorInput.taskPrompt: Fix the focused Telegram HTML formatter regression after long-message splitting moved to the adapter. The formatter test must prove that long content is preserved instead of enforcing the obsolete 4096-character truncation behavior.
desiredOutcomes: The focused regression reflects the formatter/adapter ownership boundary.
Long formatter output remains present and exceeds the obsolete truncation ceiling.
No runtime source is changed to satisfy a stale test.
knownFacts: Long-message splitting is already owned by the Telegram adapter.
The formatter regression still expects the former truncation behavior.
The task is a test-only correction with an executable focused oracle.
constraints: Do not modify formatter or adapter runtime code.
Do not delete or weaken the long-content assertion.
Keep verification scoped to the real formatter boundary.

tasks.title: PWA reconnect must preserve draft input

executorInput.taskPrompt: Stop transient online recovery from hard-reloading the chat application and erasing in-progress input while preserving normal real-time reconnection behavior.
desiredOutcomes: Draft input survives a transient connectivity recovery.
The PWA option responsible for reload behavior is covered by a focused regression check.
knownFacts: The failure is triggered by an online recovery event rather than normal navigation.
constraints: Do not disable offline support wholesale.
Do not require a live production session for the regression test.

tasks.title: Interrupted invocation self-heal and terminal backstop

executorInput.taskPrompt: Recover invocations whose CLI sessions were interrupted and ensure queue records cannot remain running when the normal failure write is lost, without false-matching unrelated interrupt errors.
desiredOutcomes: Missing or interrupted sessions can retry through the supported self-heal path.
Every queue execution reaches a durable terminal status or emits actionable failure evidence.
knownFacts: Idle-silent inference can be mistaken for a stalled CLI.
A failed store update can leave an invocation record in running state.
constraints: Do not kill the active runtime process during testing.
Keep terminal writes CAS-guarded and preserve negative classifier cases.

tasks.title: Keep thread project paths out of disposable checkouts

executorInput.taskPrompt: Introduce one persistent-project-path boundary for thread creation and reads so thread project paths survive disposable runtime checkout replacement.
desiredOutcomes: A reusable utility remaps runtime roots and descendants to the persistent workspace and fails closed when no persistent target exists.
Thread create, list, detail and trash reads persist the remapped project path instead of exposing a disposable checkout.
knownFacts: The runtime may execute from a disposable checkout while project state lives elsewhere.
Existing thread records may still name the runtime root or a missing runtime descendant.
constraints: Do not run a bulk migration or access production user data; migrate only thread records observed at the route boundary.
Do not copy path-mapping logic into individual thread handlers.

observableBehaviors.requirement: Create and read boundaries map an existing runtime root or descendant to the corresponding existing persistent-workspace directory and persist the mapped value.
observableBehaviors.adjudication: Exercise POST, unfiltered list, detail and trash responses through the registered Thread routes; compare response and ThreadStore state to canonical persistent paths.

observableBehaviors.requirement: A runtime descendant whose corresponding workspace entry resolves through a symlink outside the persistent workspace is rejected rather than exposed or persisted.
observableBehaviors.adjudication: Create an external directory and a workspace symlink to it, submit the matching runtime descendant through POST, and require a non-success response with no external path persisted.

observableBehaviors.requirement: An observed stored path lexically owned by the runtime but missing on disk is reset and persisted as the safe default project without failing the enclosing read.
observableBehaviors.adjudication: Seed a stale runtime descendant, read it through list, detail and trash boundaries, and require a successful response plus persisted projectPath=default.

observableBehaviors.requirement: A project-filtered list migrates matching legacy records without loading, mutating or failing because of unrelated records.
observableBehaviors.adjudication: Seed one matching runtime record and one unrelated unmappable record, issue the filtered request, and require only the matching record to migrate while the unrelated record remains unchanged.

executorInput.taskPrompt: Allow effort-aware provider CLIs to preserve supported native effort values that are newer than maintained presets, while rejecting effort for clients that do not consume it.
desiredOutcomes: Known presets remain ergonomic and unknown native values round-trip for capable providers.
Unsupported clients fail explicitly instead of silently persisting unused configuration.
knownFacts: Provider CLIs evolve independently of the local preset catalog.
Only a subset of provider adapters currently consume CLI effort.
constraints: Do not accept configuration that no adapter consumes.

executorInput.taskPrompt: Repair PR and issue tracking so registration, cursor migration, comment identity, queued owner wakes, and closure revalidation preserve durable exactly-once delivery truth.
desiredOutcomes: Existing relevant feedback is not silently skipped or duplicated.
Issue completion waits for a durably accepted wake and a fresh closure check.
knownFacts: GitHub issue comments and review comments use independent numeric ID spaces.
Queue admission can fail after a poll has observed new external state.
constraints: Do not access live GitHub during tests.
Do not claim delivery before wake admission is durable.
Preserve legacy event identity during migration.
